title: Token counters and lane controls
goal: Token counts per agent, per lane and per task (plan), and quick controls in the dashboard and Office view to retry, restart, resume or steer a stuck lane without opening the harness.
now: Wave 2 running: Control room (overview) on flash.

decisions.text: Wrote the shared CAUI helpers (tokens, ACTIONS, QUICK_STEERS, control) and checks/controls.check.mjs myself before the briefs so all three lanes share one contract.
Dashboard resume notes go to the lane folder (resume-note.txt), not tasks/, so a builder's git add -A never commits them.

User asked for a clear per-lane status view across projects. Steered the controls lane to add laneBucket (attention/running/done/ended) and project; the Control room UI is wave 2 after dash.html merges.
Pushed to origin/main (fixed an accidental new master branch on the remote).
lanes-ctl failed on GLM 5.3: 4 think-watchdog aborts (8 min plans, 0 edits). Resumed in place on deepseek-v4.1-flash with lead notes forcing one edit per sub-change.

User wants tokens by model (Opus lead, MaaS flash, GLM). Steered controls lane to add tokensByModel per lane; wave 2 adds lead usage from the Claude Code transcript (leadSession) and the by-model tables.

Wave 1 merged (3 lanes, all 13 check suites green). Real lane test on the dev runner: dashboard Retry turn, Restart server and Resume-with-note all worked; found and fixed a stale STOP file that ended a resumed run at once. Also fixed: state.json now written atomically (lanes flickered out of status), resume log fd leak.

risks: Kick and resume touch the supervisor loop: only a real lane proves them, the contract check is source level there.
GLM 5.3 UI lanes took 60 to 90 min before; LANE_TIMEOUT is 7200.
